summary: TeamNest.ai AI Conversation Mode Phase 2 (Batch 1) tested end-to-end across backend + web + mobile. Backend: 16/17 passed, 1 skipped (rotate — only os@radciti.com present in Sam's provisioned list and we skipped rotating it per instructions). Preferences GET/PUT, workspace settings GET/PUT (owner-only enforced), security settings GET/PUT (+ negative-day rejection), provisioned-accounts listing, roles picker (owner+member), save-to-role, and temp_password_expired helper logic all verified. Web /ai-memory settings UI: all 14 required testids render, toggle→save→reload persistence confirmed, 'Preferences saved' toast shown. Mobile /settings/ai-conversation via You → 'AI Conversation Mode' link: all pref toggles, pill selectors, workspace admin card, and security card render; save flow works (Alert shown). Sam's prefs, workspace settings, and expiry_days reset to defaults after testing.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Save' button overlaps the days-input row on 390px width (visible in /tmp/mobile_ai_settings.png bottom card) — button and input on the same row without wrap.

issues: Days input + Save button on same horizontal row can overlap on narrow screens; consider wrapping or spacing.

action_items: Optional: minor layout fix in /app/mobile/app/settings/ai-conversation.tsx to prevent Save button overlapping days input on narrow screens.

Documentation nit: /app/memory/test_credentials.md describes mate1@test.io as a 'Free member' but the account is actually owner of its own workspace. Use raj@demo.team (or any member-role user) for future 'non-admin 403' checks — this suite has been updated to use raj.

Consider adding chat-header-menu-btn / chat-save-to-role-btn e2e test on web — not verified in this run because no chat was open in the initial nav path; code review of ChatHeader.jsx + SaveToRoleDialog.jsx confirms the testids exist.
critical_code_review_comments: services/ai_conversation.py routing correctly honors effective settings: personal_ai bypasses eff.enabled (line 316), workspace enabled/allow_in_group_chats hard-gate group flow (line 323), ask_when_ambiguous=false auto-routes ambiguous band to AI (line 389). User auto_continue_enabled=false collapses eff.enabled to False via merge (services/workspace_settings.py:131) — behavior matches spec.
routes/admin.py rotate_temp_password returns plaintext password once — good UX; consider audit-logging the rotation action alongside emit for traceability.
AIConversationSettings.jsx: PUT sends full payload; if a field was locally-set to null (e.g. Inherit), server correctly preserves via `k: v for k,v in ... if v is not None`. OK.

Mobile ai-conversation.tsx: apiPut sends the entire `prefs` object (line 101) including any unrelated keys — safe because backend PreferencesIn strips unknowns via pydantic; still, prefer sending only the 5 known fields to reduce drift risk.
